title: UNION Customers and Suppliers
description: Combine customer and supplier names into a single list using UNION.

data.text: Write a query that returns a single list of all company names from both the `Customers` and `Suppliers` tables.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT CustomerName AS CompanyName, 'Customer' AS Type
FROM Customers
UNION
SELECT SupplierName AS CompanyName, 'Supplier' AS Type
FROM Suppliers
ORDER BY CompanyName;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: UNION combines results from two queries and removes duplicates. Both SELECT statements must have the same number of columns with compatible types. UNION ALL keeps duplicates and is faster. Use UNION when you need unique rows.
